description: This file contains Celery tasks and strategies for warming up cache in Apache Superset, including various cache warmup strategies, URL fetching, and task scheduling logic.

classes.name: CacheWarmupPayload
classes.description: TypedDict defining the payload for cache warmup tasks.

classes.name: CacheWarmupTask
classes.description: TypedDict defining a cache warmup task with payload and username.

classes.name: Strategy
classes.description: Base class for cache warmup strategies, requiring implementation of get_tasks method.

classes.name: DummyStrategy
classes.description: Strategy that warms up all charts by fetching every Slice from the database.

classes.name: TopNDashboardsStrategy
classes.description: Strategy that warms up charts in the top N dashboards based on logs.

classes.name: DashboardTagsStrategy
classes.description: Strategy that warms up charts in dashboards or charts with specific tags.

methods.name: get_task
methods.description: Creates a cache warmup task for a given chart and optional dashboard, including executor info.

methods.name: get_tasks
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve list of cache warmup tasks, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: fetch_url
methods.description: Celery task to perform an HTTP PUT request to warm up cache via a specific URL.

methods.name: cache_warmup
methods.description: Main Celery task to execute a cache warmup strategy, scheduling individual URL fetch tasks.
